user.title: Connect to LandPlan
user.description: Generate an API token in the LandPlan web app: **Settings → API Tokens → Generate new token**. Paste it below.

data_description.token: Your LandPlan API token from Settings → API Tokens

plan.title: Select a plan
plan.description: Choose which LandPlan plan to surface in Home Assistant. Add the integration again to connect additional plans.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid API token — check Settings → API Tokens in LandPlan and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the LandPlan API. Check your network and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
